summary: Controller /api/v2/users and /api/v2/roles move to /api/gateway/v1/users/ and /role_definitions/; role grants and listings use role_team_assignments and role_user_assignments (filter by team, user, or content_type__api_slug and object_id). Old endpoints still work in 2.6.
questions: How do I give a user a role via the AAP 2.6 API?
How do I list a team's roles in the 2.6 API?
How do I list roles on a credential via the gateway API?

answer_card.title: RBAC API in 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
- Users: `/api/v2/users` → `/api/gateway/v1/users/`
- Roles: `/api/v2/roles` → `/api/gateway/v1/role_definitions/` (all services, includes custom roles)
- Grant a role: **POST** to `/api/gateway/v1/role_user_assignments/` or `/role_team_assignments/`
- List: `role_user_assignments/?user={id}`, `role_team_assignments/?team={id}`
- Object roles: `role_user_assignments/?content_type__api_slug=awx.credential&object_id=42`
